# @fr-tests: Write tests proving each functional requirement (FR-n), in this repo's own test style

Usage: `@fr-tests [FR-1: ...; FR-2: ...]   (no arguments = read my Design.txt)`
(If the arguments don't come through, use `@.kiro/prompts/fr-tests.md <arguments>` instead.)

Arguments: $ARGUMENTS
(If the line above shows a placeholder instead of real arguments, my arguments are the rest of my message.)

Write functional-requirement tests. Requirements: the arguments above

Follow `.claude/harness/RULES.md`. If no FRs are given, read the FRs in my `Design.txt` (the path I
give, or the one in this repo, any capitalisation; never edit it). Keep my numbering; don't invent
requirements; if one is ambiguous, state your interpretation in one line.

First list, per FR, every behaviour it states that a test can check: what a call returns
(including in the edge case the FR names), what it throws and when, and what changes afterwards.
Each of those gets a test with an exact assertion, not just "not null".

- Look at their existing tests first and use the same framework, assertion library and style.
  No new dependencies. Don't edit their test classes: create a new class `<Feature>FrTest` in the
  same package as the main class under test.
- For EACH FR: a happy-path test per behaviour statement, plus the key negative and boundary
  tests (limit reached exactly, one past it).
- Naming: JUnit 5 → `@DisplayName("FR-n: ...")` with method `frN_<behaviour>`; JUnit 4 / TestNG →
  method `frN_<behaviour>`.
- Deterministic: if the code accepts a Clock or time source, use it; never sleep. If an FR can't be
  tested without a time seam, tell me instead of faking it.
- Don't change main code. If an FR isn't implemented yet, still write its test and say it will fail.

Run only this class, using the single-class command in `.claude/harness/REPO_NOTES.md`, and show the
result. For each failure, say whether the test or the code is wrong, and change nothing until I
say so. End with a table: FR | behaviour statement | test, then **How to run**: the exact
commands (from `.claude/harness/REPO_NOTES.md`) to run this class, one of its methods, and all tests.
